edges.mechanism: Raised INR, bleeding and bruising reported with glucosamine or glucosamine-chondroitin; most WHO cases resolved on withdrawal. Glucosamine did not inhibit CYP2C9/2C19 in volunteers, so the mechanism is unknown.
edges.evidence: Case report plus 20 FDA MedWatch and 21 WHO spontaneous reports; negative human CYP phenotyping study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Extrapolated from warfarin INR/bleeding reports; no data for DOACs or antiplatelets.
edges.evidence: Pharmacovigilance for warfarin only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: 2KCl-stabilized glucosamine sulfate delivers roughly 200-280 mg potassium per daily dose, usually unlabelled; additive potassium load with drugs that raise serum potassium.
edges.evidence: Product potassium assay and RCT showing serum K+ rise vs NaCl form; interaction itself unstudied; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Hexosamine-pathway concern from animal data; human studies mostly show no glycemic change, and data in diabetes are limited.
edges.evidence: SR of 11 human studies, narrative review, 24-month T2DM cohort; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Additive analgesia; GS plus celecoxib showed synergistic NF-kB inhibition in OA chondrocytes in vitro.
edges.evidence: NMA (glucosamine + ibuprofen pain SMD -2.27, moderate quality); in vitro study

edges.mechanism: Common combination; complementary glycosaminoglycan substrates. Clinical added benefit is inconsistent (GAIT moderate-severe subgroup and LEGS JSN positive; Roman-Blas RCT negative).
edges.evidence: Large RCTs and MAs; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Glucosamine plus omega-3 ranked highest for knee OA pain reduction in a network MA.
edges.evidence: NMA of 30 RCTs (SMD -2.59, moderate quality per CINeMA); few trials

edges.mechanism: Additive potassium from the KCl stabilizer.
edges.evidence: Product assay; inferred interaction; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Potassium from KCl salt can be about 20% of a hemodialysis patient's daily potassium allowance; serum K+ rises versus NaCl form.
edges.evidence: Product assay and small RCT; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Hypersensitivity reactions dominate spontaneous ADR reports; allergic reactions are the commonest post-marketing AE with non-pharmaceutical-grade products.
edges.evidence: Pharmacovigilance (263/366 ADRs hypersensitivity) and post-marketing SR; shellfish status of cases unknown; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Possible rise in intraocular pressure (34% vs 12.5% with >=2 mmHg rise in one RCT, mainly older patients); FinnGen POAG HR 2.35.
edges.evidence: Two small conflicting RCTs plus biobank and pharmacovigilance data; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Studies including insulin-resistant or glucose-intolerant subjects more often detected glycemic effects; long-term T2DM cohort showed no HbA1c change.
Brain hyperglycosylation as disease driver; oral glucosamine impaired cognition in AD mice and EHR use was associated with faster progression and worse survival.
edges.evidence: Animal plus retrospective EHR data; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: True pharmacodynamic rise in INR in warfarin-treated patients, not assay interference.
Small physiological rise with the KCl salt form (within normal range in healthy OA patients).
Generally unchanged; check in insulin-resistant users.
